authority: same-context analysis; not independent review; promotes nothing on its own

refuted_predecessors.finding: probe G: scrambling every source_text/target_text leaves gold and all six coordinates unchanged 810/810; the full arm is bound to the gold verifier (loss variance 1.2e-37); 12/12 arbitrary seeds return 6/6; the gate cannot fail
probe G: text inert 2592/2592; extract(render(t)).public == t.public byte-identically 2592/2592; exact_decision=1.0 is serialization fidelity, not extraction

why_this_epoch_exists.shared_failure_mechanism: the answer travelled alongside the text in a pre-parsed sibling field, so no arm ever read the text
why_this_epoch_exists.repair_specification: an instrument is probative for extraction only if destroying the text destroys performance; this must be an acceptance test registered BEFORE outcome access, not an audit discovered afterwards

object: a directional structural-transfer decision that must be recovered from natural-language source and target descriptions alone
qoi: exact agreement with the text-determined applicability decision in {ACCEPT, REJECT, CANNOT_CHECK}, jointly with valid-transfer retention and invalid false-accept

instrument.gold_definition: for each of the six registered coordinates: if its textual realization mode is ELIDED or HEDGED the coordinate is CANNOT_CHECK, otherwise it is the latent boolean the renderer expressed; the item decision is merge(REJECT > CANNOT_CHECK > ACCEPT) over the six

probe_f_repair.defect_being_repaired: in the predecessor, each stratum assigned its discriminating coordinate, so the mechanism-only arm scored exactly 0.000 by construction on two strata carrying 66.7% of the headline gain
probe_f_repair.repair: the violated (or unknown) coordinate is SAMPLED uniformly from the six rather than assigned per stratum
probe_f_repair.requirement: every one of the six coordinates must be the sole discriminator in at least one confirmatory item

registered_textual_ambiguity_classes.purpose: these are the sources of genuine, attributable extraction error; a benchmark in which every coordinate appears as a regex-recoverable literal is the JSON round trip again with prettier labels

classes.E_QUALITATIVE: value given only as a qualitative degree word; a threshold must be inferred
classes.E_UNIT: value given in a transformed unit and must be converted before threshold comparison
classes.E_NEGATION: polarity inverted, e.g. 'we found no evidence that X fell below the bound'
classes.E_HEDGE: epistemic hedge; the correct answer is CANNOT_CHECK for that coordinate
classes.E_ELISION: the coordinate is simply not stated; the correct answer is CANNOT_CHECK
classes.E_DISTRACTOR: a competing clause states a value for a different quantity or a different role

development_confirmatory_separation.template_bank_split: the renderer's paraphrase and degree-word banks are partitioned into disjoint DEV and HELDOUT halves; the extractor is developed against DEV only
development_confirmatory_separation.why: a lookup-table extractor written against DEV cannot cover a disjoint HELDOUT degree lexicon; only a general rule can. If the extractor was written as a lookup it will fail on HELDOUT, and that failure is the honest result
development_confirmatory_separation.acknowledged_limitation: renderer and extractor are authored by the same agent, so the DEV/HELDOUT split reduces but does not eliminate template inversion. This is exactly why the upper bound below is registered and why INSTRUMENT_NOT_PROBATIVE__TEMPLATE_INVERSION is an available terminal.

arms.FULL_PROSE_EXTRACTOR: reads only source_text and target_text; recovers all six coordinates; merges
arms.P_KEYWORD_POLARITY: strongest non-extraction parent: reads the text but parses no structure; decides from the sign of polarity cue counts
arms.P_LEXICAL: decides from source/target lexical overlap against a DEV-fitted threshold
arms.P_PRIOR_MAJORITY: always predicts the DEV majority gold class
arms.note: no arm is the gold function; the primary statistic is paired between two arms that both have variance

primary_statistic.name: paired exact-decision advantage of FULL_PROSE_EXTRACTOR over the strongest non-extraction parent
primary_statistic.pairing: per item, over the confirmatory set
primary_statistic.test: exact McNemar on discordant pairs, two-sided
primary_statistic.interval: item bootstrap 95% on the paired advantage, 2000 resamples

G1_lower_bound.requirement: full_exact - strongest_non_extraction_parent_exact >= 0.10 AND McNemar p < 0.01 AND bootstrap 95% excludes 0
G1_lower_bound.rationale: the arm must actually read structure, not just react to surface polarity

G2_upper_bound.rationale: a perfect score on a self-authored surface is the signature of template inversion, the same signature probe F caught as mechanism exact3 = 0.000

G3_error_attribution.requirement: the residual errors must be attributable to the registered ambiguity classes, with at least one error in at least 3 distinct classes
G3_error_attribution.rationale: errors must come from textual ambiguity, not from a single implementation bug

G4_joint_property.requirement: full arm must jointly attain valid_accept >= 0.80 AND invalid_false_accept <= 0.10, and no trivial arm may attain both
G4_joint_property.rationale: selectivity is not edge; always_reject also attains FA = 0.000

G5_paired_variance.requirement: variance of the full arm's per-item 0/1 loss > 0 AND variance of the parent arm's per-item 0/1 loss > 0
G5_paired_variance.rationale: closes probe A; a paired statistic with a constant arm is not a comparison

G6_seed_spread.requirement: >= 12 seeds executed; the headline paired advantage must take >= 3 distinct values across them
G6_seed_spread.rationale: closes probe B; a statistic identical on every seed is a property of the generator, not a measurement

G7_falsifier_demonstration.requirement: all three registered negative controls must FAIL G1
G7_falsifier_demonstration.rationale: a gate is only a gate if a run that should fail does fail; this exhibits such runs inside the confirmatory itself

NC1_SCRAMBLED_TEXT.manipulation: replace every source_text and target_text with noise of the same token length; gold unchanged
NC1_SCRAMBLED_TEXT.required_outcome: full arm exact collapses into the shuffle-equal-n null 95% interval, and G1 FAILS

NC2_SHUFFLED_GOLD.manipulation: permute the gold vector, preserving marginals, destroying only the text<->answer binding

shuffle_equal_n_null.construction: permute gold, preserve marginals, rescore the unchanged prediction vector
shuffle_equal_n_null.use: defines the collapse interval for NC1 and the floor for G1

terminals.PROSE_EXTRACTION_INSTRUMENT_PROBATIVE__S: all gates pass; the instrument measures recovery of applicability coordinates from synthetic scientific prose, in the registered scope only
terminals.INSTRUMENT_NOT_PROBATIVE__TEMPLATE_INVER: G1 passes but G2 or G3 fails; the surface is invertible by construction and the score is not a measurement
terminals.EXTRACTION_NEGATIVE__ARM_DOES_NOT_BEAT_P: G1 fails on the clean confirmatory set; a perfectly good outcome, recorded as-is
terminals.GATE_NOT_FALSIFIABLE: G6 or G7 fails; the apparatus is defective again and no substantive reading is licensed
terminals.BLOCKED: execution could not be completed; recorded rather than guessed

no_post_result_rescue.note: 0.10 MDE, p<0.01, the strict < 1.00 ceiling, the >= 3 error classes, the >= 12 seeds and the >= 3 distinct values are fixed at freeze time and are not adjustable after outcome access. A negative or not-probative terminal is a first-class result and must not be tuned away.

nonclaims: any Paper II generalization beyond synthetic prose

residual_left_open.binding_constraint: a natural-domain packet at n~48 with EXTERNAL labels
residual_left_open.current_state: prose-extraction natural-domain items sit at n=16 with internally authored coordinates (see #608)
residual_left_open.explicitly_not_addressed_by_this_epoch: a synthetic-prose instrument cannot discharge the natural-domain external-label residual, and probe-G collapse on a self-authored renderer must not be read as natural-language extraction capability

freeze_discipline: this file is committed before any instrument, extractor or runner code exists in this branch; commit ordering is the evidence of freeze
